annotations.title: Get Parent Topic and Traffic Potential for one keyword

description: Parent Topic and Traffic Potential for one keyword, built from real SERP overlap across a BOUNDED set (up to 5) of related keywords — not a full keyword-to-URL reverse index, which this codebase's free stack does not have. Parent Topic is the related keyword whose SERP shares the most top-10 organic URLs with the seed's. Traffic Potential is the seed's own volume plus the volume of every candidate whose own #1-ranking URL is the exact same page as the seed's — a bounded floor, never the true total traffic across every keyword that page ranks for. FREE — no paid provider or plan gate. Up to 7 upstream calls per cache miss, each independently cached (30 days for the combined result), so look keywords up one at a time. `parentTopic`/`trafficPotential` are null, not zero, when the bounded sample carries no qualifying evidence. A keyword whose SERP has no organic result throws SEO_DATA_UNAVAILABLE rather than returning zeros.

languageCode.description: Language code (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr'). Omit it to use the project's default market language, which falls back to 'en'.

locationCode.description: DataForSEO location code. Omit it to use the project's default market, which falls back to 2840 (United States) for a project that has not set one. See dataforseo.com/help-center/locations. Some countries (e.g. Iceland, 2352) are served from Google Ads data: keyword volume/CPC/trends work, but keyword difficulty, search intent, and domain analytics are unavailable.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_keyword_potential
